title: Dig Night
description:
【Story】In a world plagued by Schizosoma—a flesh-splitting disease that turns people into ghosts—it's become normal for society to leave the cleanup to professional ghost sweepers. 

 

Ricardo, a washed-up temp cleaner, takes a job scraping ghost flesh off the streets. It’s grim work... but it pays. 

【About the Game】• Dig Night is an RPG made in RPG Maker VX Ace, blending dark comedy and surreal exploration with retro flavor.

• A Strange World:

Welcome to a city where ghostification is just another part of daily life. The atmosphere is both bleak and absurd.

• Puzzle-Solving & Mental Realms:

Ghosts linger not just in flesh—but in mind. Solve puzzles and dive into their inner worlds to uncover their pasts.

• Narrative-Driven:

The story unfolds through exploration, letting you piece together each ghost’s life—and what remains of it.

• Retro Vibes:

Pixel art and classic BGM give it the charm of old-school RPGs, with a gritty twist.

• Unique Systems:

Save by smoking cigarettes. Restore health by sleeping. Nothing here works quite like you'd expect.

 

【Controls】 

• Z key: Confirm

• X key: Menu / Cancel

• Arrow keys: Move

• Shift key: Dash

• Save    : Use Tobacco or Dead Cig

• Act → Sleep : Restores Energy if low

• F5   : Toggle Fullscreen / Windowed Mode

• F12 :Return Title (no save)

【Recommended for】• Love retro-style games

• Enjoy puzzle-solving and exploration

• Are drawn to story-rich RPGs

Appreciate dark humor with a lo-fi edge

【If you get stuck】

Tips for the walkthrough can be found in the manual link.
description_short: A dark comedy RPG set in streets and psyches.
